provenance.instrument: Code of the Township of Shaler, Chapter 225 Zoning (Ord. No. 1925, 10-14-2014, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: Chapter 225 adopted 10-14-2014 by Ord. No. 1925. Ord. No. 1966 (4-12-2022) repealed the special exception for converting a one-family house to a multifamily dwelling in R-1 to R-3. Later amendments include Ord. 1971 (2022), 1974 (2023) and 1987 (3-11-2025). eCode360 New Laws (read 2026-11-12) list Ord. 1990 (retaining walls, zoning), 1981 (zoning map) and non-zoning items. Their titles do not touch dwellings. Their text was not opened.
provenance.code_current_through_note: Date carried from the towns index. The print view read on 2026-11-12 shows no currency line. New Laws lists items to 2026-10-13.
checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit, accessory apartment or in-law provision
'Only uses listed or defined within the categories under this article shall be permitted' (225-11). R-1 and R-2 permit only one-family dwellings
The special exception for converting a one-family house into more units was repealed in 2022 (Ord. No. 1966). It no longer exists. R-3 now reads 'Special exceptions: none' (225-15D)

R-3, R-4 and R-5 permit a two-family dwelling by right on 7,500 sq ft. R-3 also permits an apartment building of no more than two units. Each unit needs its own outside door (225-15, 225-16, 225-17, 225-218)
Uses not listed anywhere may be a conditional use only in the I Industrial District (225-34)
Accessory structures: 15 ft high. Side and rear yards 10 ft in R-1 and R-4, 5 ft in R-2 and R-3 (225-24 to 225-27)
Parking: 2 spaces per dwelling unit for one- and two-family dwellings. No parking in front or side yards except on a driveway (225-35 table)
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Shaler Township Code Enforcement (shaler.org). Districts (225-6): R-1, R-2, R-3, R-4, R-5, C, P, NS, GC, I, with an overlay for Mt. Alvernia. Read on eCode360 in a browser, the chapter print view, searched in the page. Searched for accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, in-law, granny, ECHO, elder cottage, caretaker, guest house, carriage, second dwelling, accessory residential, servant, au pair, conversion, accessory unit, family member, kitchen. No ADU provision. 'Family' allows up to three unrelated persons (225-218).

term.note: No ADU term. Searched for accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, in-law, granny, ECHO, elder cottage, caretaker, guest house, carriage, second dwelling, accessory residential, servant, au pair, conversion, accessory unit, family member, kitchen.

status.note: The code has no ADU text. R-1 and R-2: 'The permitted principal use shall be one-family dwellings.'

path.note: 'Only uses listed or defined within the categories under this article shall be permitted.' A second unit on a one-family lot needs a use variance from the Zoning Hearing Board (MPC 910.2).

fallback_path.note: Same as path. 225-34 sends unlisted uses to a conditional use only in the I Industrial District, which does not reach a house lot.

value.name: Two-family dwelling
value.conditions: Permitted use. Two noncommunicating units, each with its own outside door. Lot 7,500 sq ft, width 70 ft in R-3 and 60 ft in R-4. Rear yard 20 ft, side yards 10 ft. 2 parking spaces per unit. A house on a smaller lot does not qualify without relief.

value.name: Apartment building with no more than two dwelling units
value.conditions: Listed as a permitted principal use in R-3. The two-family lot rules (7,500 sq ft, 70 ft) are read as the nearest. 225-218 defines an apartment building as three or more units without a separate outside entrance for each, which clashes with a two-unit listing.
value.note: 225-26 gives lot rules for one-family and two-family dwellings only. How far the R-3 listing reaches is unclear given the three-unit definition. Ask the zoning officer.

alternatives.note: Not ADUs. The one-family to multifamily conversion special exception was repealed by Ord. No. 1966 (4-12-2022).

zoning_districts.note: No district lists an ADU. Reading of a silent code.

historic_bypass.note: No ADU text, so no historic path. The Mt. Alvernia overlay is institutional.

types_allowed.note: No ADU form is listed. A one-family dwelling is 'A detached building containing only one dwelling unit'. An accessory structure is 'used exclusively for the purposes constituting an accessory use'.

max_height_ft.note: Accessory structure rule, not an ADU rule. 'Accessory structure: 15 feet.'

setback_side_ft.note: Accessory side yard by district: R-1 10 ft, R-2 5 ft, R-3 5 ft, R-4 10 ft. See districts.

setback_rear_ft.note: Accessory rear yard by district: R-1 10 ft, R-2 5 ft, R-3 5 ft, R-4 10 ft. See districts.

family_only.note: No ADU rule. A family is related persons with servants or guests, or up to three unrelated persons.

max_adus.note: Reading: 0 means the code allows no ADU. A one-family dwelling contains only one dwelling unit.

spaces_required.note: No ADU row. One-family or two-family dwelling: 2 parking spaces for each family dwelling unit.

min_lot_sqft.note: Lot width 70 ft. Rear yard 10 ft (25 ft on a through lot). 225-166 lets a lot held in separate ownership at the effective date be built on below these figures, and B says a yard variance shall be obtained from the Zoning Hearing Board.
